body:
These were GRADE B caps not GRADE A making them significantly weaker due to a lower quality, thus taking 14 grams of GRADE A caps may not be the smartest  idea and will most likely lead to a bad trip or something worse.  But remember the grading scale is based on the vendor/cultivator of the caps so use with caution!
Two friends of mine (we'll call them Jake and jack), Decided to try Fly Agaric (amanita Muscaria). It arrived in the mail and it was 28 grams (1 OZ) of dried Grade B Washington state fly agaric caps. Jake and Jack split the oz down the middle receiving 14 grams each. Jake and jack and I first smoked Herbal incense containing JWH-018 (at the time was fully legal). Jack and Jake then decided to take the Fly Agaric keep in mind that this is all occurring in the middle of the forest. I decided to be the trip sitter and did not take any; they both eat the Fly agric caps claiming that they taste like almonds.
Thirty minutes later Jake begins to feel mild effects of the Fly agric but claims that it could just be the Herbal Incense. An hour later and he is feeling the effects of the Fly agric claiming that he feels one with nature and a spacious endless feeling. We then decide to go to McDonalds, with me and Jake taking a path and Jack taking a path (all leading to the same exit), at this time Jack is feeling nothing but a very mild effect (Jack does weigh a lot more than Jake so this would make sense). For some reason Jack gets lost in the woods (he eventually finds his way out but we didnt wait for him so he was far behind us). Me and Jake smoke more Herbal Incense on the way to McDonalds (we walked there), he is feeling really tripped out at the time and is loving it. We finally get to McDonalds and soon after we order our food Jake begins to shiver feeling extremely cold but still loving the effects. After we leave the effect worsens with his lips turning slightly blue (the cold/rainy weather could have contributed to this effect). As we head back to Jack's, house Jake explains the effects claiming that its close to a psychedelic  effect feeling spacious but there werent really hallucinations , his vision was severely blurred in a trippy sort of way and could not read the largest of text (not even directly in front of him).
All in all the effect lasted roughly 6 hours were Jake base lined.  While Jack never felt anything more than a mild buzz for 2-3 hours, this was most likely caused by the weight difference.
Positive:
Decent euphoria
Natural feeling
Spacious feeling
Trippy mind set
Negative:
Slight Nausea
Low body Temperature
Temporary difficulty of vision
Fatigue
